description: Candidate regional deployment geometries for the sentinel design separability diagnostic. Each preset is a fleet geometry, not a fitted design: a set of itinerary rotations, how many ships fly each, how their sail days are staggered, and the ashore exposure a call generates. picard_framework/analysis/sentinel/design_presets.py expands one deterministically into a ship x port x week visit table. Numbers are the orders of magnitude the stakeholder world-model document proposes for each region; they are not tuned to produce any particular separability verdict.

field_notes.n_weeks: calendar horizon; week labels are W00..W(n_weeks-1)
field_notes.sail_day_stagger: distinct sail-day offsets spread across the ships of one rotation; 1 means the whole fleet sails in lockstep
field_notes.rotations: itinerary templates: itinerary_days is the cycle length, call_days are port-call day offsets within the cycle, port_pool is a [start, end) slice of the region's port list
field_notes.port_step: how far one ship's port assignment is rotated within the pool relative to the previous ship on the same rotation; 0 means every ship calls at the same port on the same cycle day (total itinerary overlap)
field_notes.cycle_shift: how far the port assignment rotates from one cycle to the next
field_notes.n_ships_share: relative number of ships flying this rotation
field_notes.port_exposure_scale: per-port multiplier on ashore person-hours, keyed by index into the region's port list; tender-only or short-call ports get a small value

caribbean_partial_overlap.label: Caribbean: dense partially-overlapping network, three rotations, staggered sail days

alaska_full_overlap.label: Alaska: small near-fully-overlapping network, fleet in lockstep on two weekly loops

mediterranean_sparse.label: Mediterranean: sparser network, 7-12 day itineraries, six sail-day offsets

pilot_eight_ship.label: Pilot: eight ships, one rotation, four sail-day offsets

degenerate_lockstep.label: Control: one port per fleet-week, every ship on the same day - port and week are one column

staggered_control.label: Control: the degenerate geometry with the ships' port assignments staggered instead

sweep_base_ten_day.label: Sweep base: one call per 10-day cycle, sail_day_stagger is the knob under test
